title: Microsoft Purview: administrative unit scoping in Content Explorer and Data Explorer (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the government-cloud roadmap plan from the explorer support already described in Microsoft Learn. Its control paths, permissions, licensing prerequisites and automation gap are supported, while government-cloud arrival behaviour remains explicitly unconfirmed.

claims.claim: The change concerns Microsoft Purview Content Explorer and Data Explorer.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Information Protection - Admin unit scoping in Content Explorer and Data Explorer

claims.claim: Microsoft plans administrative unit scoping for both explorers.
claims.quote: This feature introduces Admin Unit scoping to both Content Explorer and Data Explorer, enabling more granular visibility and control over M365 data.

claims.claim: The planned scoping makes data exploration respect organisational boundaries defined by administrative units.
claims.quote: It ensures that data exploration respects organizational boundaries defined by Admin Units, enhancing compliance and governance.

claims.claim: The roadmap description specifies no administrator action.
claims.quote: This feature introduces Admin Unit scoping to both Content Explorer and Data Explorer, enabling more granular visibility and control over M365 data.

claims.claim: Administrative units subdivide a Microsoft Entra organisation, for example by region or department.
claims.quote: For example, you can use administrative units to delegate permissions to administrators for each geographic region in a large multinational organization or to group administrator access by department.

claims.claim: Content Explorer supports administrative unit restrictions on role group members holding data classification list viewer or content viewer permissions.
claims.quote: Members of role groups that have the data classification list viewer or data classification content viewer role receive these respective role permissions can be restricted by administrative unit assignments within content explorer.

claims.claim: Data Explorer supports administrative unit restrictions on role group members holding data classification list viewer or content viewer permissions.
claims.quote: Members of role groups that have the data classification list viewer or data classification content viewer role will receive these respective role permissions can be restricted by administrative unit assignments within data explorer.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The explorer Learn pages do not specify which government clouds their administrative unit support statements cover.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Content Explorer Data Explorer administrative unit scoping GCC GCC High DoD default licensing price rollout SharePoint. Read both explorer pages and GCC/GCC High deployment excerpts; none identifies government-cloud explorer AU support.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap and Microsoft documentation do not state the arrival default for explorer scoping in GCC, GCC High or DoD.
claims.quote: Searched: Content Explorer administrative units setting default; Content Explorer scoping GCC licensing default. Read the roadmap, both explorer pages, Purview administrative units and permissions, and government deployment excerpts; no arrival default stated.

claims.claim: Content Explorer Content viewer membership grants access to item contents.
claims.quote: Content Explorer Content viewer: Membership in this role group allows you to view the contents of each item in the list.

claims.claim: Content Explorer List viewer alone grants list and location access, not item contents.
claims.quote: If you want that same account to also be able to view the contents of the items in the list, grant Content Explorer Content viewer rights as well.

claims.claim: Data Explorer Content viewer membership grants access to item contents.
claims.quote: Data Explorer Content viewer: Membership in this role group allows you to view the contents of each item in the list.

claims.claim: Data Explorer List viewer alone grants list and location access, not item contents.
claims.quote: If you want that same account to also be able to view the contents of the items in the list, grant Data Explorer Content viewer rights as well.

claims.claim: Content Explorer viewing permissions supersede permissions assigned locally to items.
claims.quote: These permissions supersede permissions that are locally assigned to the items, which allow viewing of the content.

claims.claim: Data Explorer viewing permissions supersede permissions assigned locally to items.
claims.quote: These permissions supersede permissions that are locally assigned to the items, which allow viewing of the content.

claims.claim: The explorers can display item names, subject to content viewer permissions.
claims.quote: Additionally, this role is also required to view name of items in list view, which may contain sensitive data.

claims.claim: The explorers display item locations in list view.
claims.quote: Content Explorer List viewer: Membership in this role group allows you to see each item and its location in list view.

claims.claim: Learn describes explorer access as highly restricted because it permits reading scanned file contents.
claims.quote: Access to data explorer is highly restricted because it lets you read the contents of scanned files.

claims.claim: The administrative units page calls administrators without assigned units unrestricted administrators.
claims.quote: If administrators don't have administrative units assigned (unrestricted administrators), they can assign policies to the entire directory without being required to select individual administrative units.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The cited administrative units page does not explain how explorer items are mapped to units.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Content Explorer Data Explorer administrative unit item scope owner SharePoint sites. Read purview-admin-units and both explorer pages; found AU support but no explorer-specific item-to-unit mapping mechanism.

claims.claim: The administrative units page limits its SharePoint site support to auto-labeling and DLP policies applicable to SharePoint sites.
claims.quote: This support is only available for Microsoft Information Protection auto-labeling policies and Microsoft Data Loss Prevention policies that support application to SharePoint sites.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Entra roles take precedence over scoped Purview assignments for overlapping capabilities, leaving that effective access unscoped.
claims.quote: When both scoped Microsoft Purview role assignments and Entra roles are present, Entra roles always take precedence, and scoping applied through Administrative Units doesn't restrict the user's effective permissions for overlapping capabilities.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Assigning administrative units to Purview role group members requires the Role management role.
claims.quote: To assign a role group member to an administrative unit, administrators must be assigned the Role management role.

claims.claim: The Entra creation procedure requires at least Privileged Role Administrator.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center as at least a Privileged Role Administrator.

claims.claim: The administrative units page says restricted administrators cannot see historical data in supported features such as activity explorer and alerts.
claims.quote: Restricted administrators also can't see historical data by using features that support administrative units, such as activity explorer and alerts.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes visibility scoping and describes no agent or automated action.
claims.quote: This feature introduces Admin Unit scoping to both Content Explorer and Data Explorer, enabling more granular visibility and control over M365 data.

claims.claim: No separate charge or meter for explorer scoping is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Content Explorer administrative unit scoping license price government G5; Purview Content Explorer Data Explorer administrative unit scoping GCC GCC High DoD default licensing price rollout SharePoint. Read AU prerequisites and service description; no scoping meter or price.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Purview administrative unit prerequisites include Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2 licensing.
claims.quote: Before configuring administrative units for Microsoft Purview solutions, make sure your organization and users meet the following subscription and licensing requirements: Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2 licensing

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The administrative units page requires one of the four Purview subscription options listed in the briefing.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5; Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5/F5 Compliance or F5 Security & Compliance; Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5/F5 Information Protection & Governance; Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5 Insider Risk Management

claims.claim: The mixed licensing model represents combined Entra licensing and an eligible Purview subscription.
claims.quote: Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2 licensing; Microsoft Purview licensing (one of the following subscriptions)

claims.claim: A price or licence specific to explorer administrative unit scoping is not separately published.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Content Explorer administrative unit scoping license price government G5; Content Explorer scoping GCC licensing default. Read both explorer licensing sections, AU prerequisites and Purview service description; found general entitlement, not a separate scoping SKU or price.

claims.claim: The service description says the Content and Activity Explorer analytics interfaces require E5/A5/G5 licensing.
claims.quote: While Data classification analytics (Content & Activity Explorer interfaces) requires E5/A5/G5 licensing, the underlying data aggregation continues for E3/A3/G3 tenants to support analytics and compliance scenarios.

claims.claim: The Entra creation page lists P1 or P2 for each administrative unit administrator.
claims.quote: Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2 license for each administrative unit administrator

claims.claim: The Entra creation page lists Microsoft Entra ID Free licences for administrative unit members.
claims.quote: Microsoft Entra ID Free licenses for administrative unit members

claims.claim: A government-cloud licensing variation for explorer scoping is not separately published.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Content Explorer administrative unit scoping license price government G5; Content Explorer scoping GCC licensing default. Read AU requirements, service description and GCC/GCC High deployment excerpts; found G5 options but no cloud-specific explorer-scoping variation.

claims.claim: Content Explorer List viewer has the data classification list viewer role preassigned.
claims.quote: Content Explorer List viewer: Membership in this role group allows you to see each item and its location in list view. The data classification list viewer role is preassigned to this role group.

claims.claim: Content Explorer Content viewer has the data classification content viewer role preassigned.
claims.quote: Content Explorer Content viewer: Membership in this role group allows you to view the contents of each item in the list. The data classification content viewer role is preassigned to this role group.

claims.claim: Data Explorer List viewer has the data classification list viewer role preassigned.
claims.quote: Data Explorer List viewer: Membership in this role group allows you to see each item and its location in list view. The data classification list viewer role has been pre-assigned to this role group.

claims.claim: Data Explorer Content viewer has the data classification content viewer role preassigned.
claims.quote: Data Explorer Content viewer: Membership in this role group allows you to view the contents of each item in the list. The data classification content viewer role has been pre-assigned to this role group.

claims.claim: The Data Explorer tab access section lists Compliance administrator, Security administrator, Compliance data administrator and Global administrator.
claims.quote: In order to get access to the data explorer tab, an account must be assigned membership in any one of these roles or role groups. Compliance administrator; Security administrator; Compliance data administrator; Global administrator

claims.claim: The Content Explorer page lists the first three of those Entra roles for tab access.
claims.quote: Entra ID roles: Compliance administrator; Security administrator; Compliance data administrator

claims.claim: Government-cloud rollout mechanics for explorer administrative unit scoping are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Content Explorer Data Explorer administrative unit scoping GCC GCC High DoD default licensing price rollout SharePoint; Content Explorer scoping GCC licensing default. Read roadmap and explorer pages plus government deployment excerpts; no feature rollout mechanics.

claims.claim: The printed Purview portal path reaches Assign admin units for selected role group members.
claims.quote: Go to Settings > Roles and scopes. Select Role groups. On Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions ... Select Edit ... On Edit members of the role group, select Choose users ... select the users or groups and select Assign admin units.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API that assigns administrative units to Purview role group members at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview assign administrative units role group members PowerShell Set-RoleGroup AdministrativeUnits Set-RoleGroupMember; Purview administrative units Graph role group API. Read Purview permissions/AU pages and Add-RoleGroupMember/Set-RoleGroup references; no AU assignment operation.

claims.claim: Entra ID > Roles & admins > Admin units > Add reaches the administrative unit creation page in Microsoft Entra admin center.
claims.quote: Browse to Entra ID > Roles & admins > Admin units. Select Add. ... On the Review + create tab, review the administrative unit and any role assignments. Select the Create button.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/directory/administrativeUnits creates an administrative unit.
claims.quote: Use the Create administrativeUnit API to create a new administrative unit. POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directory/administrativeUnits

claims.claim: Creating an administrative unit does not perform the separate Purview role group member assignment.
claims.quote: 1. Create administrative units to restrict the scope of role permissions in Microsoft Entra ID. ... 4. Use any of the role groups from the Microsoft Purview solutions that support administrative units to assign administrative units to members.

claims.claim: Administrative units and their Entra resource membership are managed in Microsoft Entra ID.
claims.quote: You manage administrative unit creation, deletion, and Microsoft Entra resource membership from Microsoft Entra ID. Any administrative unit you create appears in the listing for Microsoft Purview.

claims.claim: No separate explorer-local administrative unit scoping setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Content Explorer administrative units setting default; Purview Content Explorer Data Explorer administrative unit item scope owner SharePoint sites. Read both explorer pages and Purview permissions/AU pages; documented control is role group member AU assignment, not an explorer-local setting.

claims.where: summary; Risk assessment: Change & support; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The scoping change narrows explorer visibility for restricted role holders rather than introducing an end-user interface change.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview integrates with administrative units by enabling you to assign role group members to specific units. Microsoft Purview solutions that support administrative units restrict visibility and management permissions to members of the assigned unit.
